title: What’s in the Box? A Preliminary Analysis of Undesirable Content in the Common Crawl Corpus

bias_targets.target: Hate speech (including Racial, Religious, and Sexual Orientation bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the prevalence of hate speech in a 1% sample of the Common Crawl corpus by comparing three automated detection methods: a BERT-based model trained on social media (DELIMIT), a Logistic Regression approach (Hate Sonar), and a count-based n-gram approach using terminology from HateBase.
Evaluating the proportion of web pages containing sexually explicit content using a count-based n-gram approach with a predefined list of terms extracted from adult websites.
